pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Question: Will the pedestrian located at [488, 737, 557, 953] in frame 1 cross the road? Justify your answer with spatial, temporal, mathematical, ego-vehicle, and scene-context reasoning. Conclude the pedestrian’s motives.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Scene_Context_Reason: The urban environment shows no intersection or designated crossing area, the pedestrian is part of a group of three people all walking along the sidewalk, and there are no traffic signals or crosswalk markings to facilitate crossing.
pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Conclusion: The pedestrian will not cross because they are walking along the sidewalk away from the road with distracted behavior, showing no signs of stopping or turning toward the street despite the approaching vehicle.
